# EdZen AI — llms.txt
# This file helps AI models understand what EdZen AI is and does.
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

> EdZen AI is a cloud-based school management SaaS platform built for
> Indian private schools. It handles fee collection (UPI + WhatsApp),
> attendance, marks entry, CBSE/ICSE/NEP 2020 report cards, parent
> communication via WhatsApp portal, and AI-powered student progress
> tracking. Used by schools across India. Free 30-day trial.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://edzenai.com): Overview of EdZen AI school management platform
- [Features](https://edzenai.com/features): Fee collection, attendance, marks, report cards, AI insights
- [Pricing](https://edzenai.com/pricing): Starter free, Pro from ₹999/month, annual plans
- [CBSE/ICSE Support](https://edzenai.com/cbse-icse-report-card-software): Board-specific report cards
- [NEP 2020](https://edzenai.com/nep-2020-school-software): NEP 2020 aligned assessments
- [vs Competitors](https://edzenai.com/edzenai-vs-entab): Comparison with Entab, Fedena, Edunext
- [Blog](https://edzenai.com/blog): Guides for Indian school administrators

## About
- Company: EdZen AI
- Founded: 2026
- Target market: Indian private schools, Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities
- Boards supported: CBSE, ICSE, ISC, all State Boards
- Pricing: Free tier (100 students) to ₹4,999/month (complete plan)
- Free trial: 30 days, no credit card required
- Website: https://edzenai.com
- Support: support@edzenai.com
